facts.fact: 2023 年 7 月 1 日，Alba 在 Rosa 父母位于 West Rogers Park 的车库里看 Rosa 与 Caralora 做幽灵车，死者是 18 岁的 Lily Hanko，三个女孩在 Critical Mass 认识她
facts.anchor: “A girl named Lily Hanko. We knew her from Critical Mass. She was only eighteen.”

facts.fact: 家属同意立纪念，Gomez 问是不是同一个司机；Alba 说警方这么认为，但每次车都不一样、全是偷来的，人抓不到
facts.anchor: “They think so,” I reply. “But it’s never the same car. The cars were all stolen. He’s gone before anyone can get to him.”

facts.fact: 六周内第三辆幽灵车；Alba 用铅笔手写 Lily 的名字和生卒日期，Rosa 打磨车架，三人不用商量就分工
facts.anchor: We don’t discuss any of this; this is the third ghost bike we have made in the last six weeks, and we are good at it now, and we are angry.

facts.fact: Zach 提出用 Alba 压力下会消失这一点做诱饵计划，Caralora 立刻反对，说「What if she gets killed?」
facts.anchor: “I have an idea, or actually, it’s Older Alba’s idea,” Zach says. “What if we could make use of Alba’s tendency to vanish under stress—?”

facts.fact: 7 月 8 日出发当天，Zach 承认车是黑色 Camry、当天就会发生；他说 Max 和 Joe 会在现场等着，但拒绝告诉 Alba 具体地点
撞击瞬间由 Zach 复述：Alba 被抛到空中像一记罚球，然后消失；他分不清她是时间旅行还是摔落，最后在街上找到裸着蜷缩、昏迷的她
facts.anchor: Alba is thrown high and seems to hang in the air like a free throw—and then she’s gone.

facts.fact: 医院里 Zach 求婚，未来的 Alba 说出自己来自 2024 年 7 月 15 日，把答复留到 Zach 走到那一天，两人约定保密
facts.anchor: “I’m a year ahead of you. July 15, 2024, is the day I came from. My self over there in the bed is sound asleep; she doesn’t know what we’re talking about. Let’s keep this between us, and when you get to me, next July, I’ll give you my answer.”

facts.fact: 周一晚上 Alba 用写字板向刚拔了两颗智齿的 Lucinda 讨要牙齿，理由是年长的自己要、而且是要给 Isadora 用；Lucinda 最后把装牙的密封袋送给她
facts.anchor: One of my older selves asked me to ask you. She said it was important, and that it’s for Isadora.
